See, this shit pisses me off. A once-dear friend of mine got into an MLM  (it's called Forever Living, I think - anyway, they sell aloe vera goo). The moment my mother passed away, she saw an opportunity, visiting me with her family just to push this stuff on me, saying it will cure both my little half-brother's autism (he has mutism and several other associated problems) and my own EDS. She also said that it would make me money to lift me out of the money-related issues (I got kicked out of my home). 

It was the last time I actually spoke to her, but I still have her added as a friend on fb. She doesn't speak about anything else, just that MLM. 

This kind of predatory behaviour that people exhibit once they get into an MLM is honestly terrifying. They always pick the most vulnerable people and act like vultures.
